Operations Performance & Workflow Analytics

View project case study

Objective

Monitor monthly workflow volume and compare allocated work, videos created, and sign-offs.

Dashboard elements

  • Headline KPI cards for the three workflow measures.
  • Month slicer for September, October, and November.
  • Monthly comparison chart and month-wise KPI cards.

Analytical focus

Compare monthly workload and completion indicators to help identify changes in workflow volume.

View project case study

Objective

Track PPT creation targets, sign-offs, pending work, and QC1 progress for the November 2024 reporting cycle.

Dashboard elements

  • Monthly target, sign-off, and pending KPI cards.
  • Subject-level comparisons for Chemistry, Maths, and Physics.
  • Separate views for overall monthly progress and QC1 status.

Analytical focus

Compare target versus completed and pending work by subject to make workload gaps easier to spot.

View project case study

Objective

Explore Yamaha sales performance across products, customer segments, cities, states, and months.

Dashboard elements

  • Total units sold and total revenue KPI cards.
  • Revenue by model and revenue by customer segment.
  • Units sold by city, with state and month slicers.

Analytical focus

Compare product and geographic performance and use slicers to investigate differences across markets and periods.

View project case study

Objective

Present an executive-level view of sales, profit, and operational fulfilment indicators.

Dashboard elements

  • Profit by region and customer segment.
  • Daily sales trend and sales by year.
  • Average days to pack and weekday-versus-weekend sales.
  • Order priority and ship mode slicers.

Analytical focus

Use interactive spreadsheet reporting to compare sales and operational patterns across customer, region, and fulfilment dimensions.
